# M18-S7 REDTEAM #194: eject keeps a region program's output.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosarena

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^7 42 6$'
cp stdout $WORK/native-stdout.txt
env GOEXPERIMENT=

logos eject -o out
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native-stdout.txt
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
cd ../..
cd m2
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosarena
logos run .
stdout '^5200 18 55$'
cp stdout $WORK/native2-stdout.txt
env GOEXPERIMENT=
logos eject -o out
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native2-stdout.txt
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/regionparity

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"logos/arena"
)

type node struct {
	v int
}

func main() {
	r := arena.Open()
	p := arena.New[node](r)
	p.v = 7
	s := arena.Make[int](r, 3)
	for i := range s {
		s[i] = i * i
	}
	t := arena.Append[int](r, nil, 1, 2, 3)
	sum := 0
	for _, v := range t {
		sum += v
	}
	fmt.Println(p.v, p.v*6, sum)
}
-- m2/go.mod --
module example.com/regionparity2

go 1.27

-- m2/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"logos/arena"
)

func fibR(r arena.Region, n int) int {
	t := arena.New[int](r)
	*t = n
	if n < 2 {
		return *t
	}
	a := fibR(r, n - 1)
	b := fibR(r, n - 2)
	*t = a + b
	return *t
}

func main() {
	r := arena.Open()
	total := 0
	for i := range 50 {
		s := arena.Make[int](r, 4)
		for j := range s {
			s[j] = i + j
		}
		for _, v := range s {
			total += v
		}
	}
	inner := 0
	{
		rIn := arena.Open()
		t := arena.Append[int](rIn, nil, 5, 6, 7)
		for _, v := range t {
			inner += v
		}
	}
	fmt.Println(total, inner, fibR(r, 10))
}
